core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace, Lordswood, Chatham, Kent ME5
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham, at a guide price of £285,000. The property is freehold. There is no onward chain.

The lounge measures 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). There is a lean-to utility. The first bedroom measures 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"). The second bedroom measures 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"). The third bedroom measures 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). The bathroom has a shower over the bath.

The rear garden measures approx. 9m (30ft) and has a gate to the shared rear path. Parking is on-street and no permit is required.

Gas central heating is provided by a Worcester boiler installed in 2019.

Guide Price £285,000. Tenure: Freehold. Council Tax: Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating: C. Construction: Standard – Brick under a concrete tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Parking: On-street, no permit required. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
